The heading in SIL’s OFL.txt reads “SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE Version 1.1 - 26 February 2007”. This identifies the edition despite the unversioned filename. This explains why the edition heading alone cannot settle a particular font’s RFN status. Capture 5958eddc9bb84b49aa1d5b77f0a4141a.
